name: Mustelids
description: Mustelids are carnivore Mammals of the weasel family, which also includes badgers, otters, martens and stoats.$(br2)Most are long-bodied and short-legged, with thick fur and scent glands, and many are fierce for their size, taking prey much larger than themselves.$(br2)They are found on every continent except Australia and Antarctica, from the Arctic tundra to tropical savanna.
